ghidra_exception.reason: Stock and candidate Ghidra C views invert the non-null and size branches and place early returns differently. Both contain exactly one printk and one memcpy, while the exact 104-byte body and P-Code operation shape agree.

claim: The candidate preserves syna_pal_mem_cpy at the offline function level: 104 bytes, 26 AArch64 instructions, equivalent normalized relocations, matching KCFI and matching P-Code operation shape, with the 11-test host contract passing twice under ASan/UBSan.
limitations: Android runtime, kernel integration and NX809J physical hardware behavior remain unverified.
The claim does not establish equivalence of unrelated functions or whole-driver behavior.
The exact Assembly and P-Code shape remain the behavior authority; the Ghidra C branch inversion is retained as a documented diagnostic artifact.
